pregunta: ¿Por qué subieron las disputas en la segunda quincena de septiembre de 2026?
origen: corrida real 20261022T181446-939743: modelo nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b vía Nightshift, datos de io-engine

turnos.texto:
{
  "acciones": [
    {
      "accion": "hipotesis",
      "hipotesis": [
        {"id": "H1", "enunciado": "El aumento de disputas en la segunda quincena de septiembre se debe principalmente a disputas por producto no recibido (product_not_received) vinculadas a entregas tardías o extraviadas."},
        {"id": "H2", "enunciado": "El aumento se debe principalmente a disputas por fraude (fraudulent) con señales como cliente nuevo, riesgo alto, país IP distinto o punto de retiro."},
        {"id": "H3", "enunciado": "El aumento se debe principalmente a disputas por cargo no reconocido (unrecognized)."},
        {"id": "H4", "enunciado": "El aumento está concentrado en transportistas y regiones con zona con atrasos, es decir, un problema operativo de entregas."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "accion": "consultar",
      "hipotesis": "H1",
      "sql": "WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 00:00:00' THEN 'segunda_quincena' ELSE 'primera_quincena' END AS quincena
  FROM canonico.disputas
  WHERE abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND abierta_en <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
)
SELECT quincena,
  count(*) AS total_disputas,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='product_not_received' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pnr_disputas,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='product_not_received' AND (entrega_tarde OR extraviado) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pnr_con_problema_entrega,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='product_not_received' AND zona_con_atrasos THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pnr_zona_atrasos
FROM d
GROUP BY quincena
ORDER BY quincena;"
    },
    {
      "accion": "consultar",
      "hipotesis": "H2",
      "sql": "WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 00:00:00' THEN 'segunda_quincena' ELSE 'primera_quincena' END AS quincena
  FROM canonico.disputas
  WHERE abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND abierta_en <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
)
SELECT quincena,
  count(*) AS total_disputas,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='fraudulent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fraude_disputas,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='fraudulent' AND sospecha_fraude THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fraude_con_sospecha,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='fraudulent' THEN senales_fraude ELSE 0 END) AS senales_fraude_total
FROM d
GROUP BY quincena
ORDER BY quincena;"
    },
    {
      "accion": "consultar",
      "hipotesis": "H3",
      "sql": "WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 00:00:00' THEN 'segunda_quincena' ELSE 'primera_quincena' END AS quincena
  FROM canonico.disputas
  WHERE abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND abierta_en <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
)
SELECT quincena,
  count(*) AS total_disputas,
  sum(CASE WHEN motivo='unrecognized' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unrecognized_disputas
FROM d
GROUP BY quincena
ORDER BY quincena;"
    },
    {
      "accion": "consultar",
      "hipotesis": "H4",
      "sql": "WITH d AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 00:00:00' THEN 'segunda_quincena' ELSE 'primera_quincena' END AS quincena
  FROM canonico.disputas
  WHERE abierta_en >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND abierta_en <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
)
SELECT quincena, transportista, region, zona_con_atrasos,
  count(*) AS disputas,
  sum(CASE WHEN causa_operativa THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_causa_operativa
FROM d
GROUP BY quincena, transportista, region, zona_con_atrasos
ORDER BY quincena, disputas DESC;"
    }
  ]
}
